cost.note: One temporary L4 builder; 45-minute Google-enforced deletion, hashed dependency lock, exact Qwen checkpoint and a single G1 development case. VM estimate uses US$1.50/hour plus a US$1 storage/network reserve for asia-southeast1. Includes 25 GiB network and one month of image storage at the full 100 GiB provisioned-disk ceiling. The image is retained for reuse; its continuing storage is about US$5/month at this ceiling.
